newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's President Klestil to leave hospital.
newsitem.headline: Austria's President Klestil to leave hospital.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil, who has been receiving treatment for pulmonary complications for the past 10 weeks, will be discharged from hospital on Tuesday, Austrian television reported.

Klestil, 64, was first admitted to Vienna's general hospital on September 13 with a severe bout of pneumonia. He was released seven weeks later only to be readmitted on November 15 with pulmonary embolism.

The head of the team of doctors looking after Klestil said he was now in "excellent" condition. He added the president would be released after an examination by U.S. lung specialist Talmadge King of Colorado University, the second U.S. doctor to have been flown in to examine the head of state.
